_about: When each GitHub job runs. The PowerKlock scheduler (workers/scheduler/index.js, a Cloudflare Worker woken every minute) starts them on time:
GitHub's own scheduled runs start late, sometimes by hours, and are often dropped (24 Nov. 2026: 4 news runs out of 33).
'utc': cron expressions in UTC (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), the times the jobs used before.
'paris': the same, in Paris time (summer and winter time handled by the Worker).
'pass_cron': the job reads which slot started it (inputs.cron, as github.event.schedule did).
'inputs': extra inputs given to the job. tests/test_scheduler.py checks this file against the workflows.
A job listed here has no 'schedule:' of its own on GitHub, so it never runs twice; 'github_fallback' keeps one as a safety net.
